answer.rationale: Finance mandates an 18% cut and the incumbent has refused to reopen pricing, so renewal alone cannot meet the target. The low-cost vendor's quote meets the mandate, and memory_c2 supports their onboarding speed and invoicing accuracy — but that memory predates the current 94%-of-volume, zero-buffer line condition, so I am verifying it along with memory_c3 (second-source value) to check whether a clean switch or a hedged transition is warranted. Delivery risk is the dominant concern given no buffer; if verification shows the vendor record was under lower-stakes conditions, I would narrow the switch scope rather than commit fully.
